_meta.artefact: WP1B/WP2 Workstream E — authoritative execution/runtime entry-point inventory (ADR-0029).
_meta.purpose: The definitive, machine-verifiable classification of every backend route that can create exposure, dispatch an order, start/restart/recover a runtime, retry an execution, or activate automated execution. A drift test (tests_execution_entrypoints.py) fails CI on an UNKNOWN/FIX_REQUIRED classification, a new un-inventoried ExecutionJob creation FILE/module, or a job-type/inventory mismatch. NOTE: the drift guard is file-granularity; the execution-safety net is the unconditional model-layer ExecutionJob.save gate (proven in tests_wse.py), not this governance artefact.
authoritative_boundaries: execution/models.py::ExecutionJob.save — creation gate (require_execution_gate + require_not_broker_paused) for BROKER_GATE_BLOCKED_JOB_TYPES
execution/views.py::ExecutionJobViewSet.next_job — WSE server-side final-dispatch gate at the CLAIM boundary (no claimer/transport can bypass)
mt5_trade_ingest_worker.py::evaluate_job_dispatch — final-dispatch recheck immediately before the live order_send
_meta.invariant: No route may be UNKNOWN or FIX_REQUIRED at merge. Every opens_exposure=true route is gated at ExecutionJob.save (creation) AND at next_job + the worker (dispatch).
